title: Jury Duty Letter
about: A letter for the court asking that a patient's jury service be put off, or excused, for a health reason, without naming the condition.

licence.terms: CC0 1.0: dedicated to the public domain. Use and adapt it freely, with no credit needed.

blocks.text: The person named above is a patient at {facility.name}. They have a health condition that would make jury service hard for them right now. To protect their privacy, this letter doesn't name the condition.

items: Please put off their service until the date below.
Please excuse them from service. The condition is not expected to get better.
They could serve with the changes listed below.

blocks.label: Changes that would help them serve

blocks.text: The court can call {facility.phone} with questions. We can talk about the patient's care only with their permission.
